{{Top|leg}}
'''Deflector plates''' were part of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Engine/Legends|engineering]] system. Alongside [[Heat dispersion vent/Legends|heat dispersion vents]], they drew heat away from vital locations and discharged them into the vacuum of [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]].
